Card art v1.0-cardart-B · full set

Every card, live and new, in the approved Vignette direction: grouped by Trigger family, then by evolution line, laid out Common › Rare › Legendary so the growth is visible. Each picture at 1x (Deck tile) and 2x (opened card). Common: flat. Rare: far hills and the moon. Legendary: stepped glow and a gold key-line.
